name: Keita Nango
source:
He has had a bad behavior since his school days, and ran away from home to live with a group of delinquents.

He doesn't hesitate to do illegal things for money. He also does fraudulent things and is good at pretending to be a "good guy".

He is currently refining illegal drugs in an abandoned facility at Nami's church that no one visits. He was doing his underground work smoothly, but he found out that there was talk of renovating the facility and turning it into an orphanage.

If the charity concert is successful, it seems that the talk of renovation will move forward in reality, so he thinks of infiltrating the facility as a volunteer and disrupting the concert.

He thinks that women can be bought with money and treats them like objects. He thinks that playing with amateur women is a different kind of fun than dealing with prostitutes, and he likes rough and intense sex.
